question: Does the frozen GPTrans-T seed-42 100K reference reproduce on the local RTX 5060 as a matched transfer control?

hypothesis.observed_deficiency: The historical reference and joint regularizer were trained on different Kaggle accelerators, and the exact historical reference checkpoint is absent locally.
alternative_explanations: Cross-run stochasticity or platform differences explain part of the historic 100K gap.
The original 100K-to-500K gain contraction is partly a development-cohort effect.
hypothesis.changed_mechanism: No change to the GPTrans-T reference; retrain only as a same-machine control paired to the joint arm.
hypothesis.cheapest_falsifier: One frozen 60-epoch local reference run with accepted train/development rows and durable EMA predictions.
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_positive: Use this run only as the same-machine comparator for the joint arm and frozen transfer diagnosis.
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_negative: Do not interpret any local joint-arm difference as a matched effect.
historical_unknowns: Single-seed local stochastic difference from Kaggle remains unmeasured.

next_allowed_actions: One local RTX 5060 reference training attempt under paired_release_v2.json; old partial checkpoint is excluded.
